purpose: The Studio app shell: icon-collapsible rail navigation with its toggle in the top-left corner, a header of breadcrumbs on the left and icon buttons on the right only, the chat-only panel on the right with its toggle in the top-right corner, the page module column beside the page column, and an h-svh layout where #studio-main is the page scroller.

inputs.name: navigation
inputs.description: Rail navigation projected from the Studio map.

inputs.name: commands
inputs.description: Command menu groups projected from the Studio map: every page.

inputs.name: breadcrumbs
inputs.description: Ancestry of the open page projected from the Studio map.

inputs.name: toolbar
inputs.description: The header icon buttons frames.module renders from the page manifest: module toggles, then actions.

inputs.name: modules
inputs.description: The module column frames.module renders while any module is open.

inputs.name: pageCommands
inputs.description: Every module toggle and cmdk action of the page, with its shortcut, listed in the command menu.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: plain stacks the sections; detail puts them in one card with the first as its head.

purpose: Home: the workspace agents as cards with their purpose, cell counts and a link to each library, and the owner's open requests when the Needs module is open.

inputs.name: home
inputs.description: Display-ready agents and, when open, needs.

purpose: One agent library: layers with jump links, groups, and a card per leaf with its status and a specimen thumbnail or excerpt.

inputs.name: gallery
inputs.description: Header, unit and layers of leaf cards, display-ready.

purpose: The head of a leaf page: back link to its library, name, shown version, status, id and IA trail, and status notes.

inputs.name: header
inputs.description: Name, id, version, status and trail.

purpose: What a leaf produces, for every agent: rendered output framed at 375, 768 and 1280 px in light and dark, or the record content as titled tables.

inputs.name: specimen
inputs.description: A viewports or record specimen.

purpose: Options pending approval, for every agent: the pinned or active version beside every newer unpinned version or draft, framed or as changed strings.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Rows of versions with a frame, strings or note preview.

purpose: The checks recorded for a leaf, each passing or reported.

inputs.name: checks
inputs.description: Check rows.

purpose: A leaf's recorded facts, inputs and the lists it reads, binds and depends on.

inputs.name: contract
inputs.description: Facts, inputs and lists.

purpose: Every recorded version of a leaf, newest first, with marks, lineage and hash.

inputs.name: history
inputs.description: Version rows.

purpose: Uses and used by, in both directions across agents, and the lineage of each version.

inputs.name: references
inputs.description: Links in both directions and lineage rows.

purpose: Each publication with its configured root and its full route table: path, page, frame, sections, status and the leaf page.

inputs.name: publications
inputs.description: Publications with root and routes.

purpose: The page module column and module chrome: one header toggle per declared module (icon button, pressed state, tooltip), the open modules stacked beside the page column in icon order, each with a title bar that collapses on click, a close button and a scroll body. Open state lives in the URL (?m=), Esc closes the top module, header actions run their data handlers, and every toggle and action is a page command with its shortcut.

inputs.name: modules
inputs.description: The manifest modules, each with its icon, label, shortcut, the page targets it points at and the pinned module section it renders.

inputs.name: actions
inputs.description: The manifest header actions with their data handlers (copy-link, copy-prompt, scroll).

inputs.name: children
inputs.description: Render prop that receives the toolbar, column, page commands and open ids for the app shell.

purpose: Explorer module: the page's map as a searchable tree with IA level 1 as the top grouping; a row click brings its page part into view and the part in view is highlighted.

inputs.name: explorer
inputs.description: Groups of rows (label, depth, target selector), the active target and the select callback.

purpose: Checks module: the open page's failing checks, pending options and open needs, each row linking to its leaf.

inputs.name: checks
inputs.description: A summary and three groups (failing, options, needs) of display-ready rows.

purpose: Outline module: the open page's own sections in page order; a click brings one into view and the section in view is highlighted.

inputs.name: outline
inputs.description: The page's sections (label, target selector), the active target and the select callback.
